name: promote
description: Environment-promotion pipeline with human gates: promote an already-built image through dev -> UAT -> prod by retagging it in the local registry, pausing at a manual ApprovalGate before each environment. Trigger with inputs {namespace, repo, version}: version is the source image tag build-dev produced on merge-to-dev (e.g. v1.2.3a). Each stage copies the image manifest to the next environment tag (uat, prod) only after an authorised human approves the gate, so a release never advances an environment without sign-off. No rebuild happens — the exact bytes validated in dev are the bytes promoted, so the artifact is immutable across environments.

approval.message: Promote ${inputs.namespace}/${inputs.repo}:${inputs.version} from dev to UAT? Approving copies the dev-validated image to the :uat tag.

with.run: set -e; REG=codearmory-registry-mirror:5000; ACCEPT='application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.v2+json,application/vnd.oci.image.manifest.v1+json,application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.list.v2+json,application/vnd.oci.image.index.v1+json'; echo "promoting $NS/$REPO: $SRC -> $DST"; CT=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -D - -H "Accept: $ACCEPT" "http://$REG/v2/$NS/$REPO/manifests/$SRC" | tr -d '\r' | awk -F': ' 'tolower($1)=="content-type"{print $2}' | tail -1); [ -n "$CT" ] || { echo "could not read manifest content-type for $NS/$REPO:$SRC (does the image exist in the registry?)"; exit 1; }; curl -s -H "Accept: $ACCEPT" "http://$REG/v2/$NS/$REPO/manifests/$SRC" > /tmp/m.json; [ -s /tmp/m.json ] || { echo 'empty manifest'; exit 1; }; for T in "$DST" "$DST-$SRC"; do code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/put.out -w '%{http_code}' -X PUT -H "Content-Type: $CT" "http://$REG/v2/$NS/$REPO/manifests/$T" --data-binary @/tmp/m.json); echo "tag $NS/$REPO:$T -> $code"; case "$code" in 2*) ;; *) cat /tmp/put.out; exit 1;; esac; done; echo promoted-to-uat

approval.message: Promote ${inputs.namespace}/${inputs.repo} from UAT to PRODUCTION? Approving copies the UAT image to the :prod tag. This is the production release gate.

with.run: set -e; REG=codearmory-registry-mirror:5000; ACCEPT='application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.v2+json,application/vnd.oci.image.manifest.v1+json,application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.list.v2+json,application/vnd.oci.image.index.v1+json'; echo "promoting $NS/$REPO: $SRC -> $DST"; CT=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -D - -H "Accept: $ACCEPT" "http://$REG/v2/$NS/$REPO/manifests/$SRC" | tr -d '\r' | awk -F': ' 'tolower($1)=="content-type"{print $2}' | tail -1); [ -n "$CT" ] || { echo "could not read manifest content-type for $NS/$REPO:$SRC"; exit 1; }; curl -s -H "Accept: $ACCEPT" "http://$REG/v2/$NS/$REPO/manifests/$SRC" > /tmp/m.json; [ -s /tmp/m.json ] || { echo 'empty manifest'; exit 1; }; for T in "$DST" "$DST-$VER"; do code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/put.out -w '%{http_code}' -X PUT -H "Content-Type: $CT" "http://$REG/v2/$NS/$REPO/manifests/$T" --data-binary @/tmp/m.json); echo "tag $NS/$REPO:$T -> $code"; case "$code" in 2*) ;; *) cat /tmp/put.out; exit 1;; esac; done; echo promoted-to-prod
